purpose: Turn the zero-user and zero-feedback baseline into a 10-slot reviewer sprint that can produce resume-safe public evidence without inflating current outcomes.
resume_safe_summary: Published a CI-verified first-10 reviewer sprint with 10 public evidence slots, 6 target metrics, zero sent outreach, and zero upgraded outcome claims.
